description.html: This 4.8-liter glass aquarium (20x17x14 cm) is compact enough to fit on a desk, shelf or dresser. Despite its smaller volume, it offers enough room for plants and a few small fish.
The compact dimensions allow creative decoration with small plants and pebbles. The recommended filter is a sponge filter with an air pump, which does not create too strong a current for small fish.

If you are looking for non-standard dimensions or have special requirements (reinforced bottom, lid, openings for equipment), contact us. We handmake every aquarium and ship it by courier anywhere in Serbia.
